lines.beaver_en: How was your school visit this time?
lines.en: It fell short. Even the teachers' office was a mess.

lines.learner: 새 건물은 아니어도 강당은 깨끗할 줄 알았어요.
lines.en: Maybe not a new building, but I thought the auditorium would be clean.
lines.roman: sae geonmureun anieodo gangdangeun kkaekkeutal jul arasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Was the auditorium really that bad?
lines.en: Every wall had graffiti, and the chairs were old.

lines.beaver_en: How about getting to and from school? I hear it's far.
lines.learner: 통학 버스가 없어서 등교에 한 시간이 걸려요.
lines.en: There's no school bus, so getting there takes an hour.
lines.roman: tonghak beoseuga eopseoseo deunggyoe han sigani geollyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What do they usually do after school?
lines.en: When school's over, they all go to cram schools.

lines.beaver_en: So private education is still going strong?
lines.learner: 공교육이 사교육을 못 따라가요. 교육열 탓이죠.
lines.en: Public schools can't keep up. It's the education fever.
lines.roman: gonggyoyugi sagyoyugeul mot ttaragayo. gyoyungnyeol tasijyo.

lines.beaver_en: What about going on to college? Track choices?
lines.learner: 인문계는 줄고 다들 자연계로만 가려고 해요.
lines.en: Humanities is shrinking; everyone wants science.
lines.roman: inmungyeneun julgo dadeul jayeongyeroman garyeogo haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Isn't the college entry rate high?
lines.learner: 장학생은 못 돼도 대학은 다 갈 줄 알았어요.
lines.en: Not scholarship students, but I thought they'd all go to college.
lines.roman: janghaksaengeun mot dwaedo daehageun da gal jul arasseoyo.

lines.learner: 고졸 취업이 꽤 많아요. 계열과 상관없이요.
lines.en: Many get jobs right after high school, whatever their track.
lines.roman: gojol chwieobi kkwae manayo. gyeyeolgwa sanggwaneopsiyo.

lines.beaver: 보고서에 꼭 담을게요. 정리해 주셔서 고마워요.
lines.beaver_en: I'll put that in the report. Thanks for summing it up.
lines.beaver_roman: bogoseoe kkok dameulgeyo. jeongnihae jusyeoseo gomawoyo.
lines.en: Not at all. Public education really has to change.
